patch_list: Aisle-Sorted Checklist — Canada
Group remaining checklist items by supplied aisle, in natural order (A2 before A10). Unknown locations last. No floor-plan routing.
Clearer Unit Prices — Canada
Show Walmart's supplied price-per-unit in larger bold text on list items, including the shopping checklist. No guessed conversions.
Default Lists Tab — Canada
Open Lists when entering My Items. Walmart Canada 26.31 and 26.41.2.
Find Item for Linked Items — Canada
Restore Find item on linked shopping-list products so they can be linked to a different product.
Hide Ads and Sponsored Content — Canada

Collapse native ad containers and entire sponsored grid/list product cards, restoring organic cards when recycled. Includes display ads and sponsored carousels. Does not block network requests; some layouts may retain empty slots.
Patch Tools — Canada
Replace Sparky with a card-based tools menu: stock checker, barcode scanner, price history, shopping calculators, settings and backups. Includes Back navigation and dark-mode support.
Personal Price History — Canada
Record exact prices from list cards and search/browse product tiles. Tap History on list cards, or Patch tools → Price history. Recording starts after installation.
Promotion Cleanup — Canada
Collapse the shopping-list deals promotional banner. Product discounts, expiry conditions, rewards, totals and checkout are preserved. Not an app-wide ad blocker.
Quick Scanner — Canada
Add a Scan barcode shortcut to the shopping checklist, opening Walmart's native scanner and permission flow.
Remove Shop — Canada
Hide Shop from bottom navigation and redirect the default Shop tab to My Items. Explicit other tabs are preserved.
Running List Total — Canada
Checklist subtotal, remaining and collected amounts from all loaded items, including offscreen rows. Estimated CAD before tax/fees; missing prices are counted and excluded.
Sale-Ending Reminders — Canada
Make Walmart's supplied promotion expiry text prominent on list items. In-list reminders only; no invented deadlines or background notifications.
Shopping Mode — Canada
Checklist switches for keeping the screen awake, larger checkboxes and hiding collected rows. Show collected restores them without changing your list.
Stock Availability — Canada

Show list availability. On 26.41.2, read product-detail quantities into Patch tools → Stock checker with separate pickup, delivery and shipping labels. Missing numbers stay unknown; no watchlist or order-limit guesses.
